Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly updated the understanding of the release year for "The First Seven Years" to 1949, despite the correct information provided by WebSurfer indicating a release year of 1930. This incorrect update led to the wrong conclusion that "The First Seven Years" was released more recently than "Cinesound Varieties," which was actually released in 1934.
